question: Which Indian startup unveiled a system to run AI without advanced chips in April 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ziroh Labs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ziroh Labs** is an Indian startup that focuses on **data security** and **privacy-enhancing technologies**.
 
• In April 2025, Ziroh Labs unveiled a system designed to run **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** models without relying on **advanced chips** such as GPUs.
 
• The innovation leverages **homomorphic encryption**, which allows computations on encrypted data without decrypting it,
